sourceDigestNormalization: UTF-8 source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF
coverage: SQLite CLI --resume binds the same verified backup, full manifest, deletion ledger and target identity. A separate SQLite control transaction holds process-independent operation exclusion.

Each copy has an immutable bound intent; partial private staging is recopied after operation-lock acquisition, complete matching files are skipped, and final files publish exclusively as complete inodes.

SQLite database is guarded and fingerprinted before publication. Interrupted cleanup restores missing files from the backup and reapplies the same ledger under a fresh transaction. Restore-bound permanent revocations/dead purge markers remain verifiable.
Receipt and final retained/deleted file states commit atomically with the ready guard. A later process finishes JSON receipt publication without repeating fences, deletion or generation increments.

Thirteen actual child SIGKILL boundaries plus live-operation competition, altered identities, unknown files/controls/database, linked directories/sidecars, SQL content mutation, conflicting receipt and CLI recovery were exercised.

After successful recovery, real DomainDatabase learning writes survive idempotent resume unchanged. Application store startup rejects the file marker even after SQL commit. Backup manifest and original database hashes remain unchanged.
Private student media cleanup checks every manifest entry and each deletion again, preserves unknown bytes, and can replenish source files after a media-cleanup failure.
diagnosticHistory: The initial process suite exposed assertions expecting persisted empty arrays; DomainDatabase omits empty collections. Assertions now normalize absent empty collections and verify actual row removal.

The first expanded regression failed while Windows refused creation of an unprivileged file symlink. The sidecar-link test now uses a real directory junction; no Windows file-symlink privilege is claimed.

Final acceptance is the latest 38-case SQLite combination and 20-case actual PostgreSQL compatibility run. Earlier overlapping runs are retained and their failures are not counted as passing acceptance.

environment.nativeRegression: isolated Windows PostgreSQL 17.11 with synthetic data
environment.qaPostgresFinally: stopped; pg_ctl status confirmed no server running

limits: PG CLI resume remains unimplemented; its 20-case run validates existing native import/cold-restore compatibility only.
Process termination is tested; hardware power loss and arbitrary hostile same-user filesystem mutation are outside this acceptance.
Old incomplete targets without the new context/runtime protocol remain refused. Different existing bytes and unknown/linked paths are preserved.
copiedFiles/skippedFiles count ordinary files in the final successful attempt; databaseImported is separate, not a cumulative retry-byte total.
Linux CI for this new SQLite increment is tracked separately. No full specification 104, pixel/content parity, teacher/device or long-term student acceptance is claimed.
